title: Tug-of-War Net Force
body: In a tug-of-war, $$15$$ students pull on a rope. Two students pull with $$196\, \text{N}$$ each to the right, four students pull with $$98\, \text{N}$$ each to the left, five students pull with $$62\, \text{N}$$ each to the left, three students pull with $$150\, \text{N}$$ each to the right, and one student pulls with $$250\, \text{N}$$ to the left. Assuming positive direction is to the right, express the net pull on the knot in terms of the unit vector $$\hat{i}$$. $$How$$ $$big$$ $$is$$ $$the$$ $$net$$ $$pull$$ $$and$$ $$in$$ $$what$$ $$direction$$?
